recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed, and no Extension Pack follow-up is indicated unless future Extension Pack changes alter the procedure-method max cardinality.
issue_request: FHIR-30769 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for FHIR-core Procedure, applied for R5, asking that http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/procedure-method change from 0..1 to 0..* so a Procedure can carry multiple method descriptors.
initial_application: HL7/fhir commit eaba8a86ff7df1b20b2e4972f1953a3e6be11e90 applied the issue by changing source/procedure/structuredefinition-extension-procedure-method.xml from <max value="1"/> to <max value="*"/>.
additional_context: HL7/fhir commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed Procedure standard extension definitions from the core R5 source. The current core checkout has no active procedure-method StructureDefinition source; the only exact current core reference found was the OID registry entry. The FHIR Extension Pack build includes input/definitions/* and its Procedure/StructureDefinition-procedure-method.xml already has max value *.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The requested cardinality is present in the current Extension Pack source and the editable artifact is outside this FHIR core checkout, so the seed was decided as external-repo with an empty audit commit.
